title: I love this expresso coffee maker
text: I love this expresso coffee maker. I love this expresso coffee maker!  It makes a quick serving of expresso or up to 3 cups.  I would prefer if it was stainless steel in stead of aluminum, but it does it's job well. It's like a miniature percolator, but makes a nice expresso. It's small and travels easier than a coffee pot.

product_metadata.title: Tops 55729 Espresso Coffee Maker, Forever 3 Cup
features: Replacement knobs for appliances using rotary control knobs
Constructed of food-safe aluminum, will provide long-lasting use
Make 3 demitasse cups of coffee with clean, robust flavor easily in your own home; instructions insert included
Features a heat-safe knob and a removable heat-safe handle
High quality, durable silicone gasket, designed for easy cleanup
description: For coffee with clean, robust flavor, add our espresso coffee maker to your collection. Made of food-safe aluminum, this stovetop accessory will provide long-lasting use, for what seems like forever - it's in the name. Quickly make 3 demitasse cups of rich and delicious coffee in your own home with this portable and pourable device. It features a heat-safe knob and a removable, heat-safe handle to minimize potential burns. The high quality, durable silicone gasket is designed for easy cleanup, in fact, the entire espresso maker easily disassembles for cleaning. A simple, yet iconic design in coffee culture.
